fieldValues.title: A record cannot link to a record in another repository
fieldValues.statement: A repository grows large (muSrs is big), so I want to keep essays in their own repository and link from them to problems, claims and sources in muSrs and other repositories, within a federation of repositories. Today a relation or reference must resolve inside its own repository, so linking across repositories means copying records into one large repository.
source_ref: Owner, 2026-10-16: essays in their own repository linking to muSrs and other repositories within a federation
